sources.title: Wampler Pedals Pantheon Overdrive | AllThePedals
sources.excerpt: The Wampler Pantheon is a versatile overdrive pedal inspired by British breakup, offering a wide range of tones from sweet push to high-gain grind. It features independent channels for versatile sounds, with controls for bass, treble, and presence, and is a favorite for its ability to work with various guitar styles. Its dynamic response and ability to stack with other pedals make it a standout option for guitarists seeking a versatile overdrive experience, and has been compared to the Marshall BluesBreaker pedal for its core sound. What Wampler Pedals say about the Pantheon Overdrive The Wampler Pantheon gives you all the unmistakably British break up and tonal nuance found in the best of these revered circuits…. But with some fresh features and modern functionality which are all WAMPLER! A Powerful EQ Section so you tailor your sound for any gig - Includes an active Baxandall bass control so you can match the pedal to any amp/cab and fill up any room, coupled with a beautiful Presence Control gives you just the right amount of Sparkle and Sweetness. With all the controls right up there on the front, not hidden away inside, the Pantheon is all Wampler - a fresh take on shaping this amazing circuit, and instant access to all the different harmonic and overtone structures you could ever want. If you’re looking for a classically inspired drive pedal that mates perfectly with any rig, that plays nice with all your modern tone-tools, can retain all the personality and feel of your playing, AND also delivers everything from sweet and creamy push to cranked British Grind….. Go Pantheon. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists praised the Wampler Pantheon's versatility and ability to cover a wide range of overdrive sounds, from clean boost to high-gain distortion. Users found the pedal worked well with various guitars and amplifiers, with many highlighting its dynamic response and tonal flexibility. Reviewers were impressed by its ability to cut through a mix and its suitability for both single-coil and humbucker pickups. Several reviewers stated that the Pantheon is their favorite overdrive pedal and that it has earned a permanent spot on their pedalboards.
